# canton_party (Resource)

Allocates a party on a Canton participant node.

~> **Note:** Canton parties cannot be deleted from the ledger. Running `terraform destroy` removes the party from Terraform state only — the party remains on the participant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "canton_party" "validator" {
  party_id_hint = "validator"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `party_id_hint` (String) A hint for the party ID. The ledger may modify this.

### Read-Only

- `is_local` (Boolean) Whether the party is local to this participant.
- `party_id` (String) The allocated party ID.

## Import

Parties can be imported by their full party ID:

```shell
terraform import canton_party.validator "validator::1234567890"
```

After import, `party_id_hint` is set to the full party ID since the original hint cannot be recovered.
